findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed employee handwashing yet not using a barrier to shot the faucet. Discussed with PIC and the behavior was corrected using proper handwashing procedures. Ensure the employees are aware of using a barrier to shot the faucet to avoid decontaminating their hands after handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed an exposed wood on the shelving that holds the microwave. The coating on the wood surface appears to have eroded off overtime. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the surface will be coated with appropriate coating to have this corrected. Ensure that this wood is resealed/repainted to create a smooth and easily cleanable to provide a nonabsorbent surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.
